name: Overture Maps Foundation -- Places (CDLA-licensed subset only)

rights.license: CDLA Permissive 2.0 (for records whose `source` property is CDLA-licensed; Places also contains Apache-2.0 Foursquare-sourced and CC0 AllThePlaces-sourced records NOT covered by this record)

notes: Overture Places is NOT a single-license dataset: license varies per record by its `source` property (CDLA Permissive 2.0 for most providers, Apache 2.0 for Foursquare-sourced records, CC0 1.0 for AllThePlaces-sourced records). This record intentionally models only the CDLA-licensed subset. REVIEW_REQUIRED because OrcMaps has no per-record source-filtering implementation yet -- ingesting Places today would pull in all three licenses undifferentiated, which is not acceptable for a single clean license_class. Do not flip to official_pack_allowed=true until a filtering step (keep only `source` != Foursquare, or otherwise partition by license) exists in the pack builder, or until a decision is made to track the Apache/CC0 subsets as their own separate registry records instead.
